exposure: phthalate exposure (monomethyl phthalate (MMP), mono-n-butyl phthalate (MBP), mono-benzyl phthalate (MBzP), mono-(2-ethyl-5-hydroxyhexyl) phthalate (MEHHP), mono-(2-ethyl-5-oxohexyl) phthalate (MEOHP))
outcome: placental oxidative stress biomarkers (HO-1, HIF1a, GRP78 mRNA expression)
cohort: Placentas from 2469 participants in a large population-based cohort study were analyzed.
finding: Maternal phthalate exposure was associated with sex-specific variations in placental oxidative stress markers (HO-1, HIF1a, GRP78 mRNA expression), with stronger positive associations observed in placentas of male fetuses for MMP, MBP, MBzP, and MEHHP, and negative correlations for MEOHP in female fetuses.
